notes:
Topline: enterprise finance SaaS (underwriting + customer chat). Strong interest in Dedicated for predictable throughput and strict audit/residency. Wants reserved GPU planning for Q3 go-live. Short fragments, call paraphrase and internal AE shorthand below.

Summary bullets: 
- Heavy tail of requests: bursts around 4x baseline during batch credit windows. Concerned about tail latency during batch scoring.
- "We can tolerate 5% error at peak but not >20% latency variance" — CTO quote on call.
- Primary ask: p99 latency SLO for 512-token responses, sustained throughput guarantee for 1k-1.5k reqs/s, and predictable unit cost.
- Security: must run in customer VPC with KMS integration, SOC2 + ISO27001 preferred, data residency in NA.
- Legal asks: SLA uptime + credits, breach reporting cadence.
- Budget: prefer 12-month reserved capacity contract; procurement prefers fixed-cost predictability.

AE notes: SE Diego to run detailed kernel/quantization validation. Bring Optimize recommendations to POC.

requirements_summary: Dedicated deployment in customer VPC. SLOs: p95 < 70ms, p99 < 120ms for 512-token outputs; sustained throughput 1k-1.5k reqs/s with bursts to 4k for 10-20s. Data residency NA, KMS/HSM for key management, audit logs retained 12 months. Must support model fallback routing and per-route cost telemetry.
poc_plan: Phase 1 (3 days): baseline smoke tests — validate model compatibility, kv-cache behavior, kernel selection for 8x-A100
Phase 2 (7 days): load tests — ramp to steady 1k reqs/s, then step bursts to 4k for 30s windows; capture p50/p95/p99 and token throughput
Phase 3 (7 days): soak test — 2-week continuous run at 1k reqs/s synthetic mix (70% chat, 20% embedding, 10% rerank) to detect memory leaks, KV cache thrash, and queued latencies
Phase 4 (3 days): failover and SLA validation — test model fallback, region failover, and degraded-cost policies
Deliverables: raw logs, token-level cost breakdown, latency histograms, recommended reserved GPU count and autoscale policy, SLA draft tweaks
rep_prompts: User: Upload underwriting file. System: Summarize key risk factors and produce risk score. (avg output 320 tokens)
User: Customer chat — follow-up question with 2-shot context. (avg output 80 tokens)
System: Embed 2,000 short documents and return top-5 nearest for similarity search. (embedding workload)
System: Rerank 50 candidates for fraud hypothesis; output concise ranked list. (latency sensitive)
User: Stress long-context summarization of 5k token underwriting bundle (rare heavy tail)
poc_metrics_targets: Burst capacity: 4,000 reqs/s for 10-30s windows without queuing >500ms
Token throughput: >= 400k tokens/s across cluster during steady state
Cost: target unit token cost reduction >= 25% vs cloud-managed baseline
soak_test_plan: Week 1: ramp to 1k reqs/s steady, monitor memory, CPU, GPU utilization, KV cache hit rate
Week 2: sustain 1k reqs/s with daily 30-90s bursts to 2.5k; run nightly long-context summarization batch
Daily checkpoints: export latest latency histograms, top 10 slow traces, and cost burn projections
Escalation: any p99 > 150ms for 3 consecutive checkpoints triggers SE investigation and rollback to smaller batch sizes
